recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for core FHIR. Future TestScript value-set work belongs in HL7/fhir-testing-ig, and any cleanup of the abandoned THO code system should follow UP-266 rather than this core reconciliation.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive FHIR-I request initially asked to replace the generic TestScript 'history' operation code with history-instance, history-type, and history-system. Jira comments updated the accepted resolution to have ValueSet/testscript-operation-codes include the existing FHIR base REST interaction code system instead of maintaining a parallel TestScript operation code system.
initial_application: Commit 4672c1704c576182f143374939db33cbbcf73e74, merged by PR #1505, applied FHIR-33867 by updating source/testscript/valueset-testscript-operation-codes.xml and examples to use http://hl7.org/fhir/restful-interaction.
additional_context: UP-250, the UTG proposal created from FHIR-33867, was withdrawn because the separate TestScript operation code system should not be maintained in UTG and the revised FHIR-33867 resolution no longer used it. UP-266 remains an unresolved UTG cleanup proposal. Current core source removed TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan from source/fhir.ini and source/testscript in f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 and added the FHIR Testing IG as an additional IG.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Current core does not own the TestScript value set, the external FHIR Testing IG publishes ValueSet/testscript-operation-codes as an include of http://hl7.org/fhir/restful-interaction, and the current core restful-interaction CodeSystem contains history-instance, history-type, and history-system below abstract history.
